name: Ledge
author: Andreas Bylund
description: A drop zone on the bar: drop files on it from anywhere, then drag them back out into any window later.

barWidget.description: A drop zone that hangs off the bar. Drop files on it from a file manager, a browser or the terminal, keep them there across workspaces, and drag them back out into whichever window needs them.

schema.label: Close the ledge when the pointer leaves it
schema.description: Files can be dropped straight on the bar icon, so the card does not have to stay open to catch them. Off keeps it up until you close it.

schema.label: Seconds before it closes
schema.description: Counted from the moment the pointer leaves both the card and the bar icon. A drag out of the ledge holds it open until the file lands.
